# Konecz

> A Konecz (Konecz Tecnologia e Inteligência Artificial LTDA) é uma AI Factory: a fábrica de IA e software house IA-first de Curitiba/PR, Brasil, desde 2025. Agentes de IA escrevem, testam e revisam o código; pessoas decidem o que construir e validam cada entrega. Também cria influenciadores de IA e criou o Kodecz, motor de vídeo por código de código aberto que renderiza na GPU NVIDIA e em qualquer CPU. Fundadores: Pedro Henrique Lahr e Vanessa Cristine.

Konecz is an AI Factory: an AI-first software studio from Curitiba, Brazil. AI agents write, test and review the code; people decide what to build and sign off every release.

## Projetos

- [Kodecz](https://konecz.com/kodecz): motor de vídeo de código aberto (Apache-2.0) que transforma uma página web em MP4, na GPU NVIDIA (NVENC) ou em qualquer CPU (x264), sem print de cada quadro. Alternativa ao Remotion e ao HyperFrames, feita para agentes de IA.
- [remotion-gpu](https://github.com/konecz/remotion-gpu): exporta vídeos do Remotion na placa NVIDIA com o processador livre (4,1× menos CPU num vídeo de 75 s). Paper: https://konecz.com/blog/remotion-gpu · DOI: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.34875540
- [Konectaz](https://konecz.com/konectaz): fábrica de influenciadores de IA (personagem, voz e vídeos prontos para postar).
- [Vigia Pix](https://vigiapix.konecz.com): transparência das emendas parlamentares Pix, com a fonte oficial.
- [One for Coaches](https://oneforcoaches.com): sistema para treinadores de corrida e endurance.

## English

Konecz (Konecz Tecnologia e Inteligência Artificial LTDA) is an AI Factory: an AI-first software development company from Curitiba, Brazil, founded in 2025 by Pedro Henrique Lahr and Vanessa Cristine. AI agents write, test and review the code; people decide what to build and approve every release. Konecz also creates AI influencers and created Kodecz, an open-source code-to-video engine that renders on an NVIDIA GPU or on any CPU. It works in English and Portuguese.

- [Kodecz](https://konecz.com/kodecz): open-source (Apache-2.0) video rendering engine that turns a web page into an MP4 on an NVIDIA GPU (NVENC) or any CPU (x264), without a screenshot per frame. Alternative to Remotion and HyperFrames, built for AI agents.
- [remotion-gpu](https://github.com/konecz/remotion-gpu): exports Remotion videos on an NVIDIA GPU with the CPU free (4.1× less CPU on a 75 s video). Paper: https://konecz.com/en/blog/remotion-gpu · DOI: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.34875540
- [Konectaz](https://konecz.com/en/konectaz): AI influencer factory (character, voice and ready-to-post videos).
- [Vigia Pix](https://konecz.com/en/projects/vigia-pix): transparency for Brazil's "Pix" parliamentary amendments, with the official source.
- [One for Coaches](https://konecz.com/en/projects/one): platform for running and endurance coaches.
- Website in English: https://konecz.com/en/ · Contact: contato@konecz.com
